answer: A sybil farm would need one bonded stake plus one attested device per fake identity, so forging a thousand votes costs a thousand real stakes at risk of slashing. Participants must post a bond at a shared bridge contract before voting, and each identity is tied to a unique hardware ledge attestation signed at registration. Reputation decays unless the agent publishes a fresh sonnet-keyed challenge response each epoch, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
